title_o: When “More” Seems Like Less: Differential Price Framing Increases the Choice Share of Higher-Priced Options

replications.quote: Consistent with the differential price framing effect, the present study shows—based on 45,626 add-to-cart events and 30,426 completed product purchases on an online retailer’s website—that the choice shares of higher-priced options increase when a differential price framing strategy is used.
